explanation: It is 0 almost everywhere: at every GO and D2 step, after rewarded trials, whenever the agent has been choosing a1, and anywhere before about trial 80. It turns on only at D1 when the previous trial was unrewarded and the agent has been choosing a2, and then follows the clock from about trial 80 (it sometimes stays 0 even then, for example on the second miss in a row).
